artifact.name: agent_vega_analyst_swisnf_test_v1
artifact.title: Is paclitaxel sensitivity associated with any SWI/SNF core mutation?
artifact.procedure: Took the eight breast lines in the GDSC import. Labelled a line SWI/SNF-mutant if any of ARID1A, SMARCA4 or PBRM1 was called MUT. Compared ic50_z between the mutant and wild-type groups with a two-sided Mann-Whitney U test. No covariate adjustment; n is small enough that the test is the whole analysis. The grouping of subunits into one label is inherited from [the complex model](@agent_vega_analyst_complexes_v1) and is the step most likely to be wrong.
